verse.verse_1: By oath of those which carry away while dispersing.
verse.verse_2: Then by oath of those which carry the burdens.
verse.verse_3: Then by oath of those which move with ease.
verse.verse_4: Then by oath of those which distribute by the command.
verse.verse_5: Undoubtedly, the promise you are given is surely true.
verse.verse_6: And undoubtedly justice will surely be done.
verse.verse_7: And by oath of the decorated heaven.
verse.verse_8: You are indeed in different opinions regarding this Qur’an.
verse.verse_9: Only those who are destined to revert, are reverted from it.
verse.verse_10: Slain be those who mould from their imaginations.
verse.verse_11: Those who have forgotten in a state of intoxication.
verse.verse_12: They ask, “When will be the Day of Judgement?”
verse.verse_13: It will be on the day when they will be roasted in the fire.
verse.verse_14: And it will be said to them, “Taste your own roasting; this is what you were impatient for.”
verse.verse_15: Indeed the pious are among Gardens and water springs.
verse.verse_16: Accepting the rewards given by their Lord; they were indeed virtuous before this.
verse.verse_17: They used to sleep only a little during the night.
verse.verse_18: And used to seek forgiveness before dawn.
verse.verse_19: And the beggar and the destitute had a share in their wealth.
verse.verse_20: And in the earth are signs for those who are certain.
verse.verse_21: And in your own selves; so can you not perceive?
verse.verse_22: And in the heaven lies your sustenance, and the promise you are given.
verse.verse_23: So by oath of the Lord of the heavens and the earth, this Qur’an is the Truth, in the same language that you speak.
verse.verse_24: Did the news of Ibrahim’s honourable guests reach you (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him)?
verse.verse_25: When they came to him and said, “Peace”; he answered, “Peace”; and thought, “These people are not familiar.”
verse.verse_26: Then he went to his home – so he brought a healthy calf.
verse.verse_27: He then presented it before them and said, “Do you not eat?”
verse.verse_28: He therefore inwardly sensed fear of them; they said, “Do not fear!”; and they gave him the glad tidings of a knowledgeable son.
verse.verse_29: So his wife came screaming, and striking her forehead cried, “What! For a barren old woman?”
verse.verse_30: They said, “This is how your Lord has decreed; indeed He only is the Wise, the All Knowing.”
verse.verse_31: Said Ibrahim, “What is your task, O the sent angels?”
verse.verse_32: They said, “We have been sent towards a guilty nation.”
verse.verse_33: “To throw upon them stones of baked clay.”
verse.verse_34: “That are kept marked, with your Lord, for the transgressors.”
verse.verse_35: So We removed the people who had faith, from that town.
verse.verse_36: We therefore found just one house over there that was Muslim.
verse.verse_37: And We kept a sign remaining in it, for those who fear the painful punishment.
verse.verse_38: And in Moosa, when We sent him with a clear proof towards Firaun.
verse.verse_39: In response, he turned away along with his army and said, “He is a magician or a madman.”
verse.verse_40: We therefore seized him and his army and threw them into the sea, while he was blaming himself.
verse.verse_41: And in the tribe of A’ad, when we sent a dry windstorm upon them.
verse.verse_42: It left out nothing in its path, but which it split up into fragments.
verse.verse_43: And in the tribe of Thamud when it was told to them, “Enjoy for a while.”
verse.verse_44: In response they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the thunderbolt seized them whilst they were watching.
verse.verse_45: So they were neither able to stand up, nor were they able to take revenge.
verse.verse_46: And before them, We destroyed the people of Nooh; they were indeed a sinning nation.
verse.verse_47: And We have built the heaven with hands (the Divine Power), and it is We Who give the expanse.
verse.verse_48: And We made the earth a base, so how well do We lay out!
verse.verse_49: And We created all things in pairs, so that you may ponder.
verse.verse_50: “Therefore rush towards Allah; indeed I am from Him, a clear Herald of Warning towards you.”
verse.verse_51: “And do not appoint other deities along with Allah; indeed I am from Him, a clear Herald of Warning towards you.”
verse.verse_52: Similarly, whenever a Noble Messenger came to those before them they always said, “He is a magician or a madman.”
verse.verse_53: What! Have they willed this utterance to one another? In fact they are a rebellious people.
verse.verse_54: Therefore turn away from them (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), – so there is no blame upon you.
verse.verse_55: And advise, for advice benefits the Muslims.
verse.verse_56: And I created the jinns and men, only for them to worship Me.
verse.verse_57: I do not ask any sustenance from them, nor wish that they give Me food.
verse.verse_58: Indeed it is Allah, Who is the Greatest Sustainer, the Strong, the Able.
verse.verse_59: And indeed for these unjust is also a turn of punishment, like that of their companions – so they must not ask Me to hasten.
verse.verse_60: So ruin is for disbelievers, from their day – which they are promised.
